name: Po tu storonu «Sovyonka»
source:
Imagine the times when the secondary characters of Everlasting Summer were pioneers.
A new story, new events, a new love. This is the story of a young Tolik, Viola, and Olya, as well as other characters from those times. But is everything really so simple in this story, or is it just another illusion?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1632368158]Steam[/url]]
